response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, long-tenured software engineer with broad full-stack, mobile, and systems experience across many companies, but his resume shows no direct evidence of experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, rollout automation, or growth engineering — the core domain of this role. His career trajectory (Senior/Staff titles, small-to-mid-size companies, frequent job changes) also doesn't clearly demonstrate the Principal/IC6-level scope of owning multi-team platform initiatives that this position requires.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse engineering experience across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems
Proficient in several required languages (JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, Java, some C/C++)
Demonstrated technical leadership and knowledge-sharing via workshops, talks, and open-source project founding
concerns: No evidence of experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, feature flagging, or rollout-risk management experience
No mention of telemetry/metrics platform work or data-science collaboration central to this growth-focused role
Career history lacks clear Principal-level (IC6) scope — mostly Senior/Staff roles without evidence of leading multi-team, cross-org platform initiatives at enterprise scale

key_factors.factor: Unclear Principal-level scale/scope in prior roles
